primary_source: Blas, Pujolas, Sibiryakov, A healthy extension of Horava gravity, arXiv:0909.3525, Eqs. (12)-(18)

source_paper_quadratic_stability.gradient_ratio: P(x)/Q(x)>0 for x<0 because P>0 and Q(-u)>0

theorem: The BPS healthy nonprojectable Horava scalar quadratic sector contains a continuous two-branch coefficient family whose pole/dispersion is exactly the RTK rational mixed-kinetic form while satisfying the BPS Minkowski scalar ghost/gradient conditions.
important_scope_guard: This is an exact pole/dispersion embedding after integrating nondynamical BPS fields. It is not yet proof that the reduced BPS off-shell quadratic kernel, propagator residue, matter/source coupling, or gauge-invariant observable transfer functions equal the constructive RTK mixed-kinetic EFT. A separate pole/residue guard is required before any stronger equivalence claim.
relation_to_previous_nogo: The family uses the broader higher-spatial-operator healthy nonprojectable Horava class and lies outside the previously excluded constant-ci c4=2 khronometric subspace; the earlier narrow no-go therefore does not apply.
next_required_proofs: off-shell field/source/observable mapping between the BPS scalar and intended RTK Khronon sector
full nonlinear constraint and physical-DOF count for the selected coefficient family
FLRW and generic smooth-background scalar/tensor stability beyond short-wavelength reasoning
hierarchy/naturalness assessment if Mstar is far below MP
cubic interactions and actual strong-coupling scale
radiative stability and matter-sector Lorentz-violation constraints
non_claims: not yet a full RTK nonlinear completion
not a strong-coupling or loop-stability result
